note: Staffing and classroom norms for the resource-gap measures (Power BI). Teacher norms apply per school and per stage: a stage with students needs max(min_teachers, ceil(students / pupils_per_teacher)) teachers. Simplified: head-teacher posts and the RTE rule of 40 pupils per teacher for primary sections above 200 children are not modelled.

teachers.source: RTE Act 2009, Schedule, item 1(a): 2 teachers for up to 60 children, then one more per 30 children up to 120 (30:1)
RTE Act 2009, Schedule, item 1(b): at least one teacher each for science and maths, social studies and languages; at least one teacher for every 35 children
RMSA framework (now part of Samagra Shiksha): pupil-teacher ratio 30:1 at secondary
No statutory norm; 30:1 assumed, the same as secondary. Change it here to test other values

classrooms.source: RTE Act 2009, Schedule, item 2: an all-weather building with at least one class-room for every teacher
classrooms.status: statutory for elementary schools; applied to every school
